limits: each rank is an upper bound read from the question's logical form (an ∃ or ∀ over a decidable relation); completeness for the level is cited, not proved
name: W15_difficulty_census

provenance.source: The Gödel Method: Research and Development Handover (2026-10-22), W-15

statement: Every method decides a decidable question (nine of ten; the tenth, human_written, decides nothing) and serves a general question of rank decidable (symbolic_execution), Σ1 (saturate, lean_kernel) or Π1 (the other six). Of the product's 18 questions, 7 are decidable and promised; 3 are Σ1, 4 Π1, 3 Π2 and 1 beyond the arithmetical hierarchy, and those 11 are left open, each with what the product does instead.
